title: LingXia mock selection
description: mocks/config.json in an lxapp: which calls mocks/index.ts answers in development. Absent, or without mock, everything is real.

mock.description: all: mocks/index.ts answers every call; none: the real backend does. Default none.

overrides.description: HTTP targets ('METHOD url-glob', '*' for any method) answered the other way: real under all, mocked under none (each must then be a handler key of mocks/index.ts).
